preconditions.description: The number of grooms n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of times the princess says 'Oh...' (a) must be between 0 and 15.
The number of times the princess exclaims 'Wow!' (b) must be between 0 and 15.
The total number of grooms n must be greater than the sum of a and b.

postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output a sequence of n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 50000 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each fortune in the output sequence must be an integer between 1 and 50000.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for x in stdout.split() if int(x) > sum(int(y) for y in stdout.split()[:stdout.split().index(x)])) == a
postconditions.description: The number of times the princess says 'Oh...' must match the given count a.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for x in stdout.split() if int(x) > sum(int(y) for y in stdout.split()[:stdout.split().index(x)])) == b
postconditions.description: The number of times the princess exclaims 'Wow!' must match the given count b.
